name: Severity pills in the Review-runs accordion filter findings by severity
description: From PR #482's Agent runs tab, the seeded review's accordion (open by default) shows a severity-pill row under the verdict/score with the two seeded findings' severities (1 CRITICAL 'Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit', 1 WARNING 'N+1 query in user list endpoint'). Clicking the CRITICAL pill narrows the finding-card list to just that severity (proven by a card-count drop, not just a text match); clicking it again restores both. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (hermetic stack).
